taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Subscription state changes and actual product capability grants
controls.source_trace: Trace plan identity and payment state into server capability checks, including downgrade/cancellation and delayed webhook replay.
controls.implementation_branch: Use the effective plan transition and documented grace period, not only a payment-provider event timestamp. Events may be delayed or out of order. Identify the protected server capability and whether a later authoritative event correctly reconciles it; a retained badge or invoice alone is not product access.
controls.operational_method: Record authoritative event identity/version, provider state and the entitlement reducer rule. Feed owned events in order, then deliver an older active event after a newer cancellation and observe which generation controls the protected capability. Do not order unrelated events solely by arrival timestamp. Grace periods and corrective reconciliation are product policy; a stale badge is not continued server entitlement.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned billing fixture compare an active entitled action with the same action after an effective downgrade or canceled synthetic subscription.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A retained badge or documented grace period is not a privilege bypass; show an action forbidden by the declared plan policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Reconcile provider events and server entitlements, then verify allowed grace, downgrade and replay behavior.
